definition: Observed final UK price converted from GBP minor units
availability_rule: Same-day GBP quotes retrieved within 300 seconds; at least three complete configured direct peers for group measures
interpretation_limit: Discounted snapshot prices; no value judgement or price elasticity estimate

definition: 100 times positive lifetime reviews divided by total under the admitted Steam query contract
availability_rule: Same review contract and UTC date within 300 seconds; minimum 100 target and reference reviews; at least three complete direct peers for group measures
interpretation_limit: Selected lifetime review response; no recent sentiment or representative customer-satisfaction inference

definition: Cumulative review count under the admitted Steam query contract
availability_rule: Same review contract and UTC date within 300 seconds; at least three complete direct peers for group measures
interpretation_limit: Lifecycle-dependent accumulated review scale; not units sold or current demand

definition: Steam concurrent players at the recorded retrieval time
availability_rule: Same UTC date within 300 seconds; at least three complete direct peers for group measures
interpretation_limit: Point sample of concurrent activity; not average activity or engagement rate or retention
